programme.title: UCoL: Brighton v U Craiova

programme.title: UCoL: Hearts v Monaco
programme.desc: Action from Tynecastle Park, where Heart of Midlothian seek their first league phase win against a Monaco side with a perfect record after three games.

programme.title: UEL: Torreense v Celtic

programme.title: UEL: Sunderland v Jagiellonia

programme.title: UEL: Palace v Real Sociedad
programme.desc: Crystal Palace seek their second win of the league phase as they host Spanish side Real Sociedad at Selhurst Park. Both sides sit on five points heading into this fixture.

programme.title: UEL: Olympiacos v AC Milan

programme.title: UEL: Juventus v Omonoia
programme.desc: Action from the Allianz Stadium as Italian giants Juventus, who are unbeaten so far in the league phase, face Henning Berg's Cypriot champions AC Omonoia.

programme.title: Ultimate Pool
